name: Shinsei Futanari Idol ★ Dekatama Kei ~Tsuika Event Tenkomori! Shasei no Utage Special~
original_name: 新生 ふたなりアイドル★でかたま系 ～追加イベントてんこ盛り！射精の宴スペシャル～
source:
Riko and Mizuho's antics aren't over yet......!!

Riko: "I want to be the top of the tops! Watch me become idol queen!"
Mizuho: "It's a true privilege to work hard bringing pleasure to all my beloved fans."

Two glimmering pop tarts with wangs in their ever-wet panties go further every day to meet the skyrocketing demands of their fans...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE133224.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
莉子和瑞穗的胡闹还没有结束……！！

莉子：“我要成为顶尖中的顶尖！看我成为偶像女王吧！”
瑞穗：“努力为我最爱的粉丝们带来快乐，才是真正的荣幸。”

两个内裤永远湿漉漉、胯下悬着阳具的闪耀偶像，每天都在不断突破界限，以满足粉丝们日益高涨的要求……
